ko: 정치인들은 여론의 흐름을 살피며 발언 수위를 조절했다.
de: Die Politiker verfolgten, wie sich die öffentliche Meinung entwickelte, und passten den Ton ihrer Äußerungen an.
en: Politicians watched how public opinion was shifting and adjusted the tone of their remarks.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=여론; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0241

ko: 그 사건은 다음 날 주요 일간지의 1면을 차지했다.
de: Der Vorfall stand am nächsten Tag auf den Titelseiten der großen Tageszeitungen.
en: The incident made the front pages of the major daily newspapers the next day.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=일간지; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0242

ko: 그는 매주 신문에 경제 칼럼을 쓰고 있다.
de: Er schreibt jede Woche eine Wirtschaftskolumne für eine Zeitung.
en: He writes a weekly economics column for a newspaper.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=칼럼; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0243

ko: 확인되지 않은 허위 정보가 온라인에서 빠르게 퍼졌다.
de: Unbestätigte Falschinformationen verbreiteten sich online rasant.
en: Unverified false information spread quickly online.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=허위; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0244

ko: 회사가 문을 닫는다는 헛소문 때문에 직원들이 불안해했다.
de: Wegen des haltlosen Gerüchts, die Firma werde schließen, waren die Beschäftigten beunruhigt.
en: Employees were anxious because of a groundless rumor that the company would close.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=헛소문; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0245

ko: 대변인은 문제가 된 발언에 대해 공식적으로 해명했다.
de: Der Sprecher nahm offiziell Stellung zu der umstrittenen Äußerung.
en: The spokesperson gave an official explanation of the controversial remark.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=해명; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0246

ko: 이번 보도는 청년들이 겪는 주거 문제의 실태를 자세히 보여 준다.
de: Der Bericht zeigt im Detail, wie es um die Wohnprobleme junger Menschen tatsächlich steht.
en: The report shows in detail the reality of the housing problems young people face.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=실태; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0247

ko: 정부는 매달 지역별 일자리 현황을 발표한다.
de: Die Regierung veröffentlicht jeden Monat den aktuellen Stand der Arbeitsplätze nach Regionen.
en: Every month, the government publishes the current job situation by region.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=현황; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0248

ko: 1인 가구가 늘어나는 추세는 앞으로도 이어질 전망이다.
de: Der Trend zu immer mehr Einpersonenhaushalten wird sich voraussichtlich fortsetzen.
en: The trend toward more single-person households is expected to continue.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=추세; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0249

ko: 응답자의 절반 이상이 물가 상승을 가장 큰 걱정으로 꼽았다.
de: Mehr als die Hälfte der Befragten nannte steigende Preise als ihre größte Sorge.
en: More than half of the respondents named rising prices as their biggest worry.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=응답자; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0250

ko: 일부 언론은 신약의 효과를 과대평가해 보도했다.
de: Einige Medien überschätzten in ihren Berichten die Wirkung des neuen Medikaments.
en: Some media outlets overstated the new drug's effect in their reports.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=과대평가; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0251

ko: 기자는 어느 한쪽 편을 들지 않고 중립적인 입장에서 보도하려고 했다.
de: Der Journalist bemühte sich, ohne Partei zu ergreifen, aus einer neutralen Position zu berichten.
en: The reporter tried to report from a neutral position without taking either side.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=중립적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0252

ko: 저출산이 계속되면서 문을 닫는 초등학교가 늘고 있다.
de: Weil die Geburtenrate niedrig bleibt, schließen immer mehr Grundschulen.
en: As the birth rate stays low, more and more elementary schools are closing.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=저출산; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0253

ko: 정부는 출산율을 높이기 위해 육아 지원을 확대했다.
de: Um die Geburtenrate zu erhöhen, hat die Regierung die Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung ausgeweitet.
en: The government expanded childcare support to raise the birth rate.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=출산율; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0254

ko: 빠른 도시화로 농촌 인구가 크게 줄었다.
de: Durch die rasche Verstädterung ist die Landbevölkerung stark geschrumpft.
en: Rapid urbanization has sharply reduced the rural population.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=도시화; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0255

ko: 핵가족이 늘면서 명절 풍경도 많이 달라졌다.
de: Mit der Zunahme der Kleinfamilien haben sich auch die Feiertage stark verändert.
en: As nuclear families have become more common, holidays have changed a great deal.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=핵가족; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0256

ko: 젊은 세대와 기성세대는 일과 삶의 균형을 바라보는 시각이 다르다.
de: Die junge und die ältere Generation blicken unterschiedlich auf das Verhältnis von Arbeit und Leben.
en: The younger and older generations see the balance between work and life differently.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=기성세대; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0257

ko: 맞벌이 부부에게 자녀 양육은 여전히 큰 부담이다.
de: Für Doppelverdienerpaare ist die Kindererziehung nach wie vor eine große Belastung.
en: For dual-income couples, raising children is still a heavy burden.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=양육; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0258

ko: 이 서비스는 모든 연령층이 쉽게 이용할 수 있도록 설계되었다.
de: Dieser Dienst wurde so gestaltet, dass ihn alle Altersgruppen leicht nutzen können.
en: This service was designed so that people of all age groups can use it easily.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=연령층; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0259

ko: 물가가 오르면서 서민의 생활은 더욱 어려워졌다.
de: Mit den steigenden Preisen ist das Leben der einfachen Leute noch schwerer geworden.
en: As prices have risen, life has become even harder for ordinary people.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=서민; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0260

ko: 스마트폰 사용에 익숙하지 않은 노인들은 소외감을 느끼기 쉽다.
de: Ältere Menschen, die mit Smartphones nicht vertraut sind, fühlen sich leicht ausgegrenzt.
en: Older people who are not used to smartphones can easily feel left out.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=소외감; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0261

ko: 외국인 주민이 늘면서 학교에서도 문화적 다양성을 존중하는 교육이 중요해졌다.
de: Da immer mehr ausländische Einwohner hier leben, ist auch an Schulen eine Bildung wichtig geworden, die kulturelle Vielfalt respektiert.
en: As the number of foreign residents grows, education that respects cultural diversity has become important in schools too.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=다양성; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0262

ko: 모든 지역에 똑같이 적용되는 획일적인 기준으로는 지역별 문제를 해결하기 어렵다.
de: Mit starren Einheitskriterien, die für alle Regionen gleich gelten, lassen sich regionale Probleme kaum lösen.
en: Uniform standards applied identically to every region can hardly solve region-specific problems.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=획일적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0263

ko: 스마트폰이 보편화되면서 종이 신문을 읽는 사람이 크게 줄었다.
de: Seit Smartphones allgemein verbreitet sind, lesen deutlich weniger Menschen gedruckte Zeitungen.
en: Since smartphones became widespread, far fewer people read print newspapers.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=보편화; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0264

ko: 그 회사는 올해 신입 사원 채용을 두 배로 늘렸다.
de: Das Unternehmen hat in diesem Jahr doppelt so viele Berufseinsteiger eingestellt.
en: The company doubled its hiring of new employees this year.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=채용; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0265

ko: 연봉보다 근무 환경 때문에 이직을 결심하는 직장인이 많다.
de: Viele Angestellte entschließen sich eher wegen des Arbeitsumfelds als wegen des Gehalts zu einem Jobwechsel.
en: Many employees decide to change jobs because of the work environment rather than the salary.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=이직; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0266

ko: 안드레아 씨는 오랫동안 쌓은 실무 경험 덕분에 팀원들의 신뢰를 받는다.
de: Dank ihrer langjährigen Praxiserfahrung genießt Andrea das Vertrauen ihres Teams.
en: Thanks to years of hands-on experience, Andrea has her team's trust.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=실무; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0267

ko: 지난해 실적이 예상보다 좋아 주가가 올랐다.
de: Weil die Ergebnisse des vergangenen Jahres besser als erwartet ausfielen, stieg der Aktienkurs.
en: Last year's results were better than expected, so the share price rose.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=실적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0268

ko: 그는 계약직으로 입사한 지 2년 만에 정규직으로 전환되었다.
de: Zwei Jahre nach seinem Einstieg mit befristetem Vertrag wurde er fest angestellt.
en: Two years after joining on a fixed-term contract, he became a permanent employee.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=정규직; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0269

ko: 회사는 경영이 어렵다는 이유로 직원을 함부로 해고할 수 없다.
de: Ein Unternehmen darf Beschäftigte nicht einfach entlassen, nur weil es wirtschaftlich schwierig ist.
en: A company cannot simply dismiss employees on the grounds that business is difficult.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=해고; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0270

ko: 그는 대학을 졸업하자마자 친구들과 창업에 뛰어들었다.
de: Gleich nach dem Studium gründete er mit Freunden ein eigenes Unternehmen.
en: Right after graduating from university, he jumped into starting a business with friends.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=창업; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0271

ko: 경기가 나빠지면서 문을 닫는 자영업자가 늘고 있다.
de: Da sich die Konjunktur verschlechtert, geben immer mehr Selbstständige ihr Geschäft auf.
en: As the economy worsens, more and more self-employed people are closing their businesses.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=자영업자; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0272

ko: 온라인 판매가 늘어난 덕분에 올해 매출이 작년보다 크게 올랐다.
de: Dank des wachsenden Onlinehandels ist der Umsatz in diesem Jahr deutlich höher als im Vorjahr.
en: Thanks to growing online sales, revenue rose sharply this year compared with last year.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=매출; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0273

ko: 경기 침체가 길어지면서 소비 심리도 얼어붙었다.
de: Weil die Konjunkturflaute anhält, ist auch die Kauflaune eingebrochen.
en: As the economic slump drags on, consumer sentiment has frozen too.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=침체; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0274

ko: 은행들이 금리를 올리자 대출 이자 부담이 커졌다.
de: Als die Banken die Zinsen anhoben, stieg die Zinslast für Kredite.
en: When banks raised interest rates, the interest burden on loans grew.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=금리; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0275

ko: 이 업무는 높은 전문성이 요구되기 때문에 경력자를 우선 채용한다.
de: Da diese Tätigkeit hohe Fachkompetenz erfordert, werden bevorzugt Berufserfahrene eingestellt.
en: Because this work requires a high level of expertise, experienced candidates are hired first.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=전문성; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0276

ko: 이 논문은 이론적 배경과 실제 사례를 함께 다룬다.
de: Diese Arbeit behandelt sowohl den theoretischen Hintergrund als auch konkrete Fallbeispiele.
en: This paper covers both the theoretical background and real cases.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=이론적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0277

ko: 자료를 체계적으로 정리해 두면 나중에 분석하기가 훨씬 쉽다.
de: Wer seine Daten systematisch ordnet, kann sie später viel leichter auswerten.
en: If you organize your data systematically, it is much easier to analyze later.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=체계적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0278

ko: 자유와 평등은 국적과 관계없이 누구에게나 적용되는 보편적 가치이다.
de: Freiheit und Gleichheit sind universelle Werte, die unabhängig von der Staatsangehörigkeit für alle gelten.
en: Freedom and equality are universal values that apply to everyone regardless of nationality.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=보편적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0279

ko: 도시로 인구가 몰리고 농촌이 비는 것은 산업화 과정의 전형적인 현상이다.
de: Dass die Menschen in die Städte drängen und sich die Dörfer leeren, ist ein typisches Phänomen der Industrialisierung.
en: People crowding into cities while villages empty out is a typical phenomenon of industrialization.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=전형적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0280

ko: 이번 결과는 예외적인 경우일 수 있으므로 추가 연구가 필요하다.
de: Da dieses Ergebnis ein Ausnahmefall sein könnte, sind weitere Untersuchungen nötig.
en: This result may be an exceptional case, so further research is needed.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=예외적; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0281

ko: 이 논문은 기존 연구를 토대로 새로운 질문을 던졌다.
de: Auf der Grundlage früherer Studien warf diese Arbeit neue Fragen auf.
en: Building on earlier studies, this paper raised new questions.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=토대; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0282

ko: 기초 과학의 성과는 의료와 산업 분야에 폭넓게 응용된다.
de: Die Erkenntnisse der Grundlagenforschung werden in Medizin und Industrie breit angewendet.
en: Findings from basic science are widely applied in medicine and industry.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=응용; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0283

ko: 현아 씨는 논문 서론에서 연구의 목적과 범위를 먼저 밝혔다.
de: Hyuna legte in der Einleitung ihrer Arbeit zuerst Ziel und Umfang der Forschung dar.
en: In the introduction of her thesis, Hyuna first set out the aim and scope of the research.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=서론; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0284

ko: 대학 입시에서 논술 시험은 논리적으로 글을 쓰는 능력을 평가한다.
de: Bei der Hochschulaufnahmeprüfung bewertet der Aufsatzteil die Fähigkeit, logisch zu schreiben.
en: In university entrance exams, the essay test assesses the ability to write logically.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=논술; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0285

ko: 주장을 뒷받침할 만한 근거가 부족하면 설득력이 떨어진다.
de: Fehlen Belege, die eine Behauptung untermauern, verliert sie an Überzeugungskraft.
en: If there is not enough evidence to back up a claim, it becomes less persuasive.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=뒷받침; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0286

ko: 문제의 근원을 찾지 못하면 같은 오류가 되풀이될 수밖에 없다.
de: Wenn man die Wurzel des Problems nicht findet, wiederholt sich derselbe Fehler zwangsläufig.
en: If the root of a problem is not found, the same error is bound to recur.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=근원; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0287

ko: 복잡한 통계는 도표로 정리하면 한눈에 이해하기 쉽다.
de: Komplexe Statistiken sind auf einen Blick verständlich, wenn man sie in Diagrammen darstellt.
en: Complex statistics are easy to grasp at a glance when presented in charts.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=도표; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_c1_0288
